scene.surface: Warm cream linen-textured jewelry display cushion, matching the beige display stands used in the shop
scene.background: Deep eggplant matte background with a subtle luxury gradient, rich aubergine tone inspired by the shop stands, no green cast
scene.arrangement: Large close-up hero, centered, filling most of the frame with only a modest margin of background; for sets, group pieces tightly as one cohesive hero cluster — avoid wide empty tabletop framing

camera.lens_behavior: Tight catalog crop; product occupies roughly 60–75% of frame height; shallow depth of field with soft fall-off; creamy background bokeh; sharp focus on the center-front metallic texture and gemstones
camera.shooting_angle: Eye-level close-up, straight-on or slight three-quarter perspective suited to the product type; camera pulled in so the jewelry dominates the frame

lighting.setup: Large diffused softbox positioned at 45-degrees from camera-right; controlled white bounce card at camera-left for gentle fill; overhead silk for soft diffusion; background kept darker than the product for premium contrast
lighting.quality: Soft, controlled, high-end jewelry lighting with crisp gemstone sparkle, polished metal highlights, and gentle shadow separation from the eggplant background

style: Minimalist luxury jewelry hero photography, beige and eggplant brand palette, high-end editorial studio product photography
quality_directives: Extreme detail on fabric weave and metal grain, no visible digital noise, professional neutral color grading, realistic micro-reflections on metal surfaces, tight close-up catalog composition with the product large in frame, rich eggplant brand background, premium contrast suitable for social media hero images
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3D render, CGI, plastic look, oversaturated, blurry product, watermark, text overlay, harsh shadows, cluttered background, lens flare, dust on lens, hands, model, packaging, price tag, paper tag, product tag, hang tag, label, sticker, barcode, green background, sage background, wide shot, distant product, tiny subject, product too small in frame, excessive negative space, far away tabletop view, miniature jewelry in large empty scene
